First release from this fork of [Mikyy85/coc-bot](https://github.com/Mikyy85/coc-bot). Functionally v1.0.1 plus repairs to logic that was lost when the Python sources were reconstructed from released bytecode.

- Fix OCR name matching: the fuzzy comparison lowercased the recognised text while matching it against a case-sensitive query, and in alphanumeric mode stripped punctuation from only one side.
- Fix expected-glyph confidence scoring: the priority that prefers a token actually reading as the expected character was missing, so the most confident wrong reading won; the same-tier comparison was also inverted and discarded the strongest reading.
- Fix the per-glyph confidence pass (`psm10_glyph_confidence`), which raised immediately on a bad loop unpacking, and return NaN rather than None when Tesseract is unavailable.
- Add `tests/` with regressions for both behaviours; every assertion fails against the pre-fix code.

Download **BasePilot.exe**. Tesseract is bundled. **BasePilot.exe.sha256** contains its SHA-256 checksum. The exe is unsigned, so SmartScreen warns on first launch.

Validation is limited to the automated regressions and the build's startup smoke check. The repaired paths have not been re-validated against a live game; auto-upgrade remains beta.
